verdicts.reason: Vertical farms produce leafy greens and herbs at the scale of single plants (about 1 million kg a year for a large facility) and do not supply staple crops. Leading firms failed: AeroFarms filed for Chapter 11 in June 2023 and the UK's Jones Food Company entered administration in April 2025. Share of produce stays far below 5% at the placed year. Provisional, window closes 2031.
verdicts.mainstream_test: Share of produce supply: far below 5%; large facilities produce about 1 million kg a year each.
